title: A stale range validator returns the current resource in full
summary: Four resource routes agreed on the status, Content-Range and body for stale, matching, weak and date validators.

change.description: The range covers both submitted commits, including the final polishing commit. The resource-serving paths consult If-Range before interpreting Range.

notes: The same six-byte file, fixed modification time and ETag reach an MVC static handler, a ResponseEntity controller return-value processor, a functional MVC route and a WebFlux resource handler. Each response body is read after handling.
